title: Bifurcated Bridging Cyano Group and Network of Hydrogen-bonded Water Molecules in a Novel Framework Host Inclusion Compound Triaquacadmium(II) Tricyanocuprate(I)-Acetonitrile (1/1)
abstract: Abstract                The dimeric structure unit of [Cu2(CN)6]4− in the title inclusion compound involves two bifurcated CN groups respectively linked to two Cu(I) at the C and a Cd(II) at the N to form the framework host accommodating the CH3CN whose orientation is regulated with the hydrogen bonds among the guest and the waters of coordination in the host.
